steps.name: coingecko.stocks.token_markets
steps.role_zh: 独立采集 tokenized-stock 全分页；复用行情结构，不设价格/市值门槛。
steps.role_en: Separate tokenized-stock pagination using the same market structure, without a price or cap floor.

steps.name: Few Understand · market.snapshot
steps.role_zh: 传递单代币原始行情；此时还不是计算后的指标。
steps.role_en: Carries raw per-token observations, before indicator calculation.

steps.name: Polars · 计算 CoinGecko 量价指标
steps.role_zh: 复用同一程序与指标函数；按稳定 coin ID、来源、报价和覆盖语义匹配历史。
steps.role_en: Reuse the same program and metric functions; match history by stable coin ID, source, currency and coverage semantics.

steps.name: Polars · 汇总指标并发布
steps.label_zh: 同一 Polars 程序内汇总
steps.label_en: Assembly inside the same Polars program
steps.role_zh: 汇总子指标后发布，缺失指标保留缺失；不是额外的爬虫或计算服务。
steps.role_en: Assemble metric results and preserve missing values; this is not a separate collector or compute service.

steps.name: Few Understand · indicator.data
steps.role_zh: 只接收计算后的指标；沿用消费者要求的指标版本，不能任意混用 v1/v2。
steps.role_en: Carries computed indicators in the version required by each consumer; v1 and v2 are not interchangeable.

steps.name: CoinGecko · 24 小时大涨
steps.label_zh: 共用策略 · 24 小时大涨
steps.role_zh: 示例：24h涨幅达到10%触发关注。Stocks 是否单独展示由成员范围决定，不靠另建 Topic。
steps.role_en: Example: a 24h rise of at least 10% triggers attention. Stocks display membership does not require a separate Topic.

limits_zh: 仅为 Studio 设计展示；未运行采集、创建 Topic 或启动消费者。股票代币行情不等于原生美股。Few 实际 Header 注册、Stocks 成员存储与覆盖适配仍待核验。
limits_en: Studio design only: no collection, Topic creation or consumers. Tokenized markets are not native stock markets. Few Header registration, Stocks membership storage and coverage adaptation remain unverified.

round_design.rule_zh: 推荐由同一调度轮次启动 Crypto 与 Stocks 两个采集任务，关联同一个轮次编号和比较截止时间；它们仍分别分页、记录请求/接收时间与上游更新时间，并确认各自完整覆盖。共同排名等待两边本轮数据齐备且新鲜后再冻结计算；缺页、限流或超时明确标记不完整，不把上一轮数据冒充本轮。单市场榜可按自己的完整轮次计算。
round_design.rule_en: Recommend starting Crypto and Stocks tasks in one scheduled round with a shared round reference and comparison cutoff. Each still paginates and records request, receive and source times with its own coverage. Freeze a combined ranking only when both current-round inputs are complete and fresh. Missing pages, rate limits or timeouts remain incomplete; never substitute a previous round as current. A single-market board may use its own complete round.
round_design.cadence_zh: 测试环境当前12分钟一次为用户回报，未独立复核；生产频率沿用实际配置。未来可把共同调度周期从12分钟缩至3分钟，但须先核验全分页耗时、全局限流/额度及两边本轮完成情况。3分钟调度不保证上游同步更新，也不保证每轮3分钟内完成。本批只做卡片，不改频率或调度器。
round_design.cadence_en: The user reports a current 12-minute test cadence; deployment is not independently verified. Production follows actual configuration. A shared cadence may later move from 12 to 3 minutes after checking pagination duration, global limits/budget and completion. A 3-minute schedule does not guarantee synchronized upstream timestamps or completion within 3 minutes. This batch changes cards only, not scheduling.
